theater_event_23_04_02_069:
Where'd you lot come from?!
This ain't good—Let's bail for now, Ais-tan!
theater_event_23_04_02_071:
Jeez... What do they all take their goddess
for? They could listen to me just
a little bit...
theater_event_23_04_02_072:
But Riveria looked troubled...
I don't want to do something
Riveria hates either...
theater_event_23_04_02_074:
—Listen... There's a real deep
reason for all this.
theater_event_23_04_02_077:
—been hit with a curse that makes
Jyaga Maru-kun stop tastin' good!!
theater_event_23_04_02_079:
It's a cursed tale that'll bring tears
to yer eyes... It's a looong story...
but will ya hear me out, Ais-tan...?
theater_event_23_04_03_080:
There's a cursed spring deep down
in the Dungeon—
theater_event_23_04_03_081:
Riveria fell into it, and she got hit
with a curse that makes Jyaga Maru-kun
stop tastin' good.
theater_event_23_04_03_082:
It still ain't lifted. Every time she eats
the Jyaga Maru-kun she loved, it tastes
like mud, and she writhes in agony.
theater_event_23_04_03_084:
Riveria puts on a brave face, see.
She'd especially not want you
to see her like that.
theater_event_23_04_03_085:
But I'm her goddess too!
I ain't been sittin' around twiddlin'
my thumbs!
theater_event_23_04_03_086:
I pulled all kinda strings... and got my hands
on this blessed curse-breakin' swimsuit,
protected by the Jyaga Maru-kun spirit!
theater_event_23_04_03_088:
Put this on, and the curse lifts clean away!
She'll be able to enjoy Jyaga Maru-kun
again!
theater_event_23_04_03_089:
But 'cause of the curse, Riveria hates
swimsuits somethin' fierce... I've been
at my wit's end over what to do.
theater_event_23_04_03_090:
Then...we have to get her
into the swimsuit...!
theater_event_23_04_03_091:
Right, right?!
That's my Ais-tan! What a push—
theater_event_23_04_03_092:
—I mean! What a good kid, carin' about
her guardian! Will ya...help me get
her into this swimsuit?
theater_event_23_04_03_093:
Yes...
Jyaga Maru-kun not tasting good...
would be the end of the world...!
theater_event_23_04_03_094:
All right, Ais-tan, I'm countin' on ya
with this swimsuit! Get it on
Riveria no matter what!
theater_event_23_04_03_095:
Oh, and don't tell the other elves about
this curse, 'kay? Legend says if elves
find out, the curse'll spread...
theater_event_23_04_03_097: Whoa~ There's a curse like that~?
theater_event_23_04_03_098: Yes... The scariest curse in the world...
theater_event_23_04_03_099: Um, I'm not so sure about that part...
theater_event_23_04_03_100:
We have to get her into the
curse-breaking swimsuit somehow.
theater_event_23_04_03_101:
Um... Loki said the curse makes the other
elves get mad if you bring a swimsuit
near them too?
theater_event_23_04_03_102:
Yes... Lefiya wore a swimsuit, but she's
young, so the curse doesn't affect
her much, apparently...
theater_event_23_04_03_103:
That's weird~...
Sounds kinda like one of Loki's excuses.
theater_event_23_04_03_104:
But...
Jyaga Maru-kun tasting like mud...
is unthinkable.
theater_event_23_04_03_105:
A hell like that...
life wouldn't be worth living...
theater_event_23_04_03_106:
Well...we gotta do something
about the curse, I guess~
theater_event_23_04_03_107:
But y'know, forcing Riveria into a swimsuit
sounds about as hard as beating
a floor boss.
theater_event_23_04_03_108:
Even so...we have to.
I can't just leave it...!
theater_event_23_04_03_109:
Mm, okay!
Then I'll help too!
theater_event_23_04_03_111:
I'm worried about Riveria having
a curse on her too!
theater_event_23_04_03_112:
Let's break the curse together!
We can totally do it!
theater_event_23_04_04_115:
Yeah, it's a fairy tale I read
a long time ago—
theater_event_23_04_04_116:
It's about Mr. Sun and Mr. North Wind
trying really hard to get a traveler
to take off his clothes.
theater_event_23_04_04_118:
It's not a hero's tale, but it was
super fun! So if we do it like that
story, even Riveria will—
theater_event_23_04_04_119:
—What's the matter?
You two look awfully grim.
theater_event_23_04_04_120:
Don't tell me you two are also going
to say I should wear a swimsuit...?
theater_event_23_04_04_121:
Ahaha... As if~!
We just had a little question
for you, Riveria—
theater_event_23_04_04_124:
Sorryyy! I brought a bucket of water
to clean up, and I knocked it over!
theater_event_23_04_04_126: ...It clearly looked like you kicked it...
theater_event_23_04_04_127:
If you stay soaked, you'll catch a cold!
Here, change into these—
theater_event_23_04_04_130: She dried off in an instant?!
theater_event_23_04_04_131:
If you're going to clean, do it more
calmly. Making a bigger mess
defeats the purpose.
theater_event_23_04_04_133:
Dang it! She's tough, just like I thought!
The North Wind plan's a bust!
theater_event_23_04_04_135:
Don't sweat it! We've still got the Sun plan!
Ais, let's try it the way we talked
about earlier!
theater_event_23_04_04_139:
Yes... Piping hot.
Since I splashed you earlier...
There's also piping-hot oden...
theater_event_23_04_04_140:
Aren't an awful lot of these things
unusually hot...?
theater_event_23_04_04_141:
H-hurry and eat...! You need to warm up
from the inside...! If you catch a cold...
everyone will be in trouble...
theater_event_23_04_04_143:
Eating hot food until you're puffing and
sweaty is healthy...a really important
god said...I think.
theater_event_23_04_04_144:
I don't quite follow, but...
I suppose I can't let food go to waste...
theater_event_23_04_04_145:
Yes...!
Hurry and eat, and sweat a lot...
theater_event_23_04_04_146:
Yeah, yeah! I've got a change of
clothes ready right here—!
theater_event_23_04_04_149:
Hm... Chilled this much, it should
be quite delicious.
theater_event_23_04_04_150:
Thank you, both of you.
I'll gratefully enjoy this.
theater_event_23_04_05_153:
Hmmmmmmm...
Whatever we try, she just fixes it
with magic...
theater_event_23_04_05_154:
At this point, isn't brute force
all we've got left?
theater_event_23_04_05_156:
Yeah... If she gets serious with her magic,
we won't stand a chance...
theater_event_23_04_05_157:
But we've gotta do something
about that curse.
theater_event_23_04_05_158:
Yes...that's absolutely not okay.
A life without Jyaga Maru-kun...
theater_event_23_04_05_159:
Mmm, guess we'll just have to charge in
ready to go down swinging! If we team up,
we can at least pin Riveria down—
theater_event_23_04_05_160:
Now you're discussing something
rather dangerous, aren't you?
theater_event_23_04_05_163:
No way... Even Ms. Ais and Ms. Tiona
have become Loki's minions...
theater_event_23_04_05_165:
But...even if it's you two, I can't allow
you to humiliate high elf royalty by
forcing a swimsuit on her!
theater_event_23_04_05_168:
Phew... It looks like they didn't hear
about the curse...
theater_event_23_04_05_170:
I don't really know what's going on, but if
you're after Lady Riveria, you'll have
to go through us!
theater_event_23_04_05_173:
With this many of them, we'd have to go
all out! We might hurt somebody!
theater_event_23_04_05_176: Phew... Forcing it's tough too, huh.
theater_event_23_04_05_177:
Yes...
I don't want to fight everyone...
theater_event_23_04_05_178: What are you two up to?
theater_event_23_04_05_179:
Tione!
Perfect timing, help us out—
theater_event_23_04_05_180:
What are you talking about?! For some reason,
all the elves vanished and we're short on
patrols! You two are helping out!
theater_event_23_04_05_182:
Um... Then I'll help,
so let Ais do her own thing!
theater_event_23_04_05_184:
Ais! I'll do your share of the work too,
so you figure out how to get Riveria
into the swimsuit!
theater_event_23_04_05_186: What are you two talking about...
theater_event_23_04_05_187:
Never mind, never mind!
C'mon, let's hurry up and patrol!
theater_event_23_04_06_196:
Earlier, I...
lost my temper and said some
harsh things...
theater_event_23_04_06_197: No, I'm the one who should be sorry...
theater_event_23_04_06_199: Um... Why are you helping Loki?
theater_event_23_04_06_201:
Even if it's our goddess Loki's divine will,
I don't want anyone causing trouble
for Lady Riveria.
theater_event_23_04_06_204: Which is why...I'm torn, I guess.
theater_event_23_04_06_206:
I don't want to trouble Riveria... I don't want
to fight you and the others either...
That's how I feel, so...
theater_event_23_04_06_207:
I don't understand... In that case, couldn't
you just ignore Loki's request...?
theater_event_23_04_06_210:
(Did I...upset Ms. Ais somehow...?
I don't think I said anything strange...)
theater_event_23_04_06_211: Oh...I know! Why don't we eat these?!
theater_event_23_04_06_213:
Yes! Instead of worrying with such a serious
face, let's eat something tasty, clear our
heads, and think of a solution!
theater_event_23_04_06_214:
These are pool-exclusive "Chilled
Jyaga Maru-kun"! I wanted to eat them
with you, Ms. Ais!
theater_event_23_04_06_216:
N-not at all...! I just...don't want you
or Lady Riveria to feel bad, that's all...!
theater_event_23_04_06_217:
Let's eat. Then maybe a good idea
will come to us...
theater_event_23_04_06_222:
Huh?
W-well, it's a little different from the
usual Jyaga Maru-kun, but...?
theater_event_23_04_06_225:
Lefiya.
I really do...have to get Riveria
into a swimsuit...!
theater_event_23_04_06_226:
WHAAAAAAAT?!
How on earth did you come to
THAT conclusion?!
theater_event_23_04_07_229:
Riveria... Swimsuit... Jyaga Maru-kun...
What do I do... There's no turning back now...
theater_event_23_04_07_239:
(A flying Jyaga Maru-kun...?! If Riveria knew
something like that existed, maybe she'd
wear the curse-breaking swimsuit—!)
theater_event_23_04_07_243: Blub blub blub blub blub blub blub!!
theater_event_23_04_07_259:
(I wanted to catch it...
Then maybe I could've convinced Riveria...)
theater_event_23_04_07_276:
(That's right... I can't make anyone sad...
Not Riveria, not Lefiya, not Jyaga Maru-kun,
not anyone...)
theater_event_23_04_08_283:
Um... A way to get someone who doesn't want
to wear a swimsuit...to wear one?
theater_event_23_04_08_284: Yes. I just can't think of anything...
theater_event_23_04_08_285:
I think she's embarrassed,
and there's other stuff too, but...
theater_event_23_04_08_286: I really...need her to wear it...
theater_event_23_04_08_288:
Someone who doesn't want to...

theater_event_23_04_08_289:
Yes... A way to get her to wear it without
making anyone sad... Otherwise
there's no point...
theater_event_23_04_08_290:
But you have a reason important enough

right?
theater_event_23_04_08_293:
—If it were me...
I think I'd ask her straight out.
theater_event_23_04_08_295:
I'd talk to her as many times as it takes
until she understands, bow my head
over and over...
theater_event_23_04_08_296:
I think I'd keep asking until she could tell
I wasn't being half-hearted—that
I really, truly meant it.
theater_event_23_04_08_298:
Actually, at first, I wasn't too keen
on sneaking into this pool either.
theater_event_23_04_08_300:
But everyone invited me, and they told me
straight out that they needed me—
theater_event_23_04_08_301:
That made me really happy...
and I felt like enjoying the summer
and the pool with them.
theater_event_23_04_08_303:
Oh, I know that's no excuse
for breaking the rules, but...
theater_event_23_04_08_304:
I, um... I wanted to live up to
everyone's feelings... That's kind of
a weird example, though.
theater_event_23_04_08_305:
I'm sure...if your feelings really get
through to her, she'll wear the
swimsuit for you.
theater_event_23_04_08_306:
I could tell how serious you are,
Ms. Ais.
theater_event_23_04_08_308:
Just like you said, Bell... I'll ask her
straight out, honestly.
theater_event_23_04_09_311: —I'm beggin' ya! Please wear this swimsuit!
theater_event_23_04_09_313:
Aw, don't be so mean~
Please, I'm beggin' ya here!
theater_event_23_04_09_314:
Oh, sure! Back in Meren, you tried
to make her wear a shameless
swimsuit too!
theater_event_23_04_09_315:
No matter how many times you ask, I won't
allow you to humiliate high elf royalty!
theater_event_23_04_09_317:
Ahh, so Loki finally showed up herself.

theater_event_23_04_09_318:
Tiona, where did you run off to,
ditching patrol?!
theater_event_23_04_09_319:
Ah, uh, well, I was doing some diving
in that pool over there...
theater_event_23_04_09_320: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
theater_event_23_04_09_321:
Loki... You even dragged Ms. Ais and
Ms. Tiona into this! This time, I'm
really, truly disappointed in you!
theater_event_23_04_09_322:
N-no, that ain't it!
There's a real deep reason for this...!
theater_event_23_04_09_323:
Oh...?
I'll hear it, at least.
theater_event_23_04_09_324:
Uh, well, see, the truth is—I got a
mandatory mission to get royalty
into a swimsuit!
theater_event_23_04_09_326:
Don't look at me with those frosty eyes!

theater_event_23_04_09_327:
The pleasure quarter burnin', one Dungeon
irregular after another... Lotta weird
stuff goin' on lately, right?!
theater_event_23_04_09_328:
So the Guild entrusted me with this
swimsuit to make all of Orario happy!
theater_event_23_04_09_331:
Huh?

theater_event_23_04_09_333:
So you DID trick Ms. Ais and Ms. Tiona
into taking your side!
theater_event_23_04_09_334:
N-no, no, no?!
It's a misunderstandin'—!
theater_event_23_04_10_340:
What is it, Ais?
No matter how many times you ask,
I won't wear a swimsuit—
theater_event_23_04_10_344: I—want you to wear a swimsuit, Riveria.
theater_event_23_04_10_346:
W-wait, Ms. Ais...!
Loki's lie was just exposed...!
theater_event_23_04_10_347: This has nothing to do with Loki...!
theater_event_23_04_10_349:
I...just want...to be happy
with Riveria...that's all...!
theater_event_23_04_10_352:
I want to eat Chilled Jyaga Maru-kun...
with Riveria...in swimsuits...!
theater_event_23_04_10_354:
That's how I really feel...
I don't want you to feel bad, Riveria, but...
theater_event_23_04_10_355:
Even so...!
Chilled Jyaga Maru-kun together,
in swimsuits...!
theater_event_23_04_10_357:
U-um... I don't really get
what you're saying...?
theater_event_23_04_10_361:
So I just have to wear...
the swimsuit you've got?
theater_event_23_04_07_230:
That's right! If we played in a night pool
like that, you and I would get closer
and closer and—
theater_event_23_04_07_231:
A-and, um... we'd leap right over the wall
between god and mortal and end up
being that kind of—
theater_event_23_04_07_237:
Ah?!

theater_event_23_04_07_240:
No! Further that way!
Over by the pool!
theater_event_23_04_07_245: —Blub blub blub blub blub blub blub?!
theater_event_23_04_07_252:
You fell into the "pool," Ms. Ais.
So I...
theater_event_23_04_07_256:
Oh... What about the Unidentified
Flying Jyaga Maru-kun...?
theater_event_23_04_07_257:
I-it flew off somewhere!
Really, really fast!
theater_event_23_04_07_260:
Oh...but why are you here, Bell?
Loki said boys can't come in here...
theater_event_23_04_07_261: Well, um...how do I put this...
theater_event_23_04_07_264:
Everyone in my Familia wanted to have fun
together, so they brought me all the way here—
theater_event_23_04_07_265: They went to so much trouble just for me.
theater_event_23_04_07_266:
And I really wanted to have fun with them too!
I wanted to live up to their feelings,
so I came...
theater_event_23_04_07_267:
...I see.
Everyone really likes you, Bell.
theater_event_23_04_07_271:
Huh? I thought I heard Ms. Ais's voice.
Was it...just my imagination?
theater_event_23_04_07_274:
If you got kicked out...
I thought someone would be sad...
theater_event_23_04_07_281:
...Um, what do you think would make someone
want to wear a swimsuit?
theater_event_23_04_10_342:
I'm sure...if your feelings really get
through to her, she'll wear the
swimsuit for you.
theater_event_23_04_10_343:
I could tell how serious you are,
Ms. Ais.
theater_event_23_04_10_364:
I don't mind... It's rare for this girl
to show her own will so openly...
Once in a while can't hurt, can it?
theater_event_23_04_10_366:
Fortunately, there are no men here.
If it lifts Ais's spirits, can't you
accept it as well?
theater_event_23_04_10_368:
Lefiya...let's eat Chilled
Jyaga Maru-kun together too.
theater_event_23_04_10_371:
At long last, the impregnable "Nine Hell"
has FALLEEEEN!!
theater_event_23_04_11_377:
What a feast for the eyes...!
Burn it into your memory so you never
forget it as long as you live...!
theater_event_23_04_11_378:
...This is unbearably uncomfortable.
Let's eat our Jyaga Maru-kun somewhere
less crowded...
theater_event_23_04_11_379:
Ooh, in that case, there's a private
pool over that way! It'd be perfect!
theater_event_23_04_11_382: What was that?! I am NOT pushy!
theater_event_23_04_11_386:
What're you lot doin'?!
This is my private pool—VIPs only!!
theater_event_23_04_11_400:
L-Lady Riveria has turned to stone
from shame and humiliation?!
theater_event_23_04_11_404:
Stop scampering around!
Hold still and turn to charcoal!!
theater_event_23_04_11_407:
Are you okay, Riveria...?
Eat some Chilled Jyaga Maru-kun
and calm down...
theater_event_23_04_11_408:
...Y-yes. Sorry...
You're right. I'll have some...
theater_event_23_04_11_412:
Thank goodness...!
The curse-breaking swimsuit worked...!
theater_event_23_04_11_414:
Good for you, Ais! The curse is broken,
so now Riveria can enjoy Jyaga Maru-kun
again!
theater_event_23_04_11_415:
Yes... I'm so glad that scary curse that
ruins Jyaga Maru-kun is gone...
The spirit swimsuit is amazing...
theater_event_23_04_11_416:
What are you talking about...?
I've never heard of any such curse...
theater_event_23_04_11_418:
Don't tell me...that's why you two
wanted me in a swimsuit?
theater_event_23_04_11_422:
So that's how it is— You deceived Ais and
the others...all to put me in this
shameful state...!
theater_event_23_04_11_423: Wh-whoa?! Hold on! I was just—?!
theater_event_23_04_11_424: "Blow, third winter of the bitter cold"—!
theater_event_23_04_11_428:
How the giant midsummer pillar of ice that
towered over Summerland became Orario's
newest tourist attraction is another story—
theater_event_23_05_01_001:
Mmm. Nice weather, a nice breeze...
Perfect day for a trip.
theater_event_23_05_01_002:
Leaving Orario for days at a time...
Will we...be okay?
theater_event_23_05_01_004:
We're just going to this Pumpkeen Village
place to pick up some of this "Pumpkeen"
stuff, right?
theater_event_23_05_01_005:
It's way safer than diving into the Dungeon.
Nothing to worry about.
theater_event_23_05_01_006:
B-but...you never know what might happen...
And I don't even get what a Pumpkeen
is in the first place...
theater_event_23_05_01_007:
Lord Miach explained it, didn't he?
Well, I didn't really get it either—
theater_event_23_05_01_008:
—It's like a pumpkin, but not a pumpkin.
A super vegetable! That's the Pumpkeen!
Everyone's Pumpkeen!
theater_event_23_05_01_009:
Get this—ten times the nutrition of a pumpkin!
Plus medicinal properties! Eat it, or brew
medicine with it! That's the Pumpkeen!
theater_event_23_05_01_010:
Trick or treat!
Let's all eat Pumpkeen!!
theater_event_23_05_01_013:
Oh... We were just imitating a traveling
merchant who sometimes comes to Orario
to peddle Pumpkeen...
theater_event_23_05_01_014:
Indeed. Apparently, the village where it's

Pumpkeen, you must say those exact words.
theater_event_23_05_01_015:
Sounds like a pretty high-maintenance
village...
theater_event_23_05_01_016:
But if we had some...we might be able to make
a new product that could even beat
Dual Potions...
theater_event_23_05_01_017:
You took us in, so I'll do whatever you need,
but...don't we need the Guild's permission
to leave Orario?
theater_event_23_05_01_018:
Not a problem.
I've already obtained permission under the
pretext of new medicine development.
theater_event_23_05_01_019:
The village seems to be holding its harvest
festival right now. Take a little vacation
while you're at it and enjoy yourselves—
theater_event_23_05_01_020:
—Well, I didn't really get it.
But if we think of it as half a vacation,
it's not a bad deal, right?
theater_event_23_05_01_021:
And I'm curious about a festival
outside Orario.
theater_event_23_05_01_022:
A festival...
Uuu... Somewhere that lively...
I'd be so out of place...
theater_event_23_05_01_024:
The carriage to Pumpkeen Village
has arrived! Anyone boarding?
theater_event_23_05_01_027:
Here, take this. Snacks I bought at the
Blazing Bee. Let's eat them while we
enjoy the view from the carriage.
theater_event_23_05_01_029:
Excuse me—
Please let me aboard as well.
theater_event_23_05_01_030:
Go on, hop in.
We're about to head out.
theater_event_23_05_01_032:
Huh... Aren't you a waitress from
The Benevolent Mistress?
theater_event_23_05_01_033: And you are...from the Apollo Familia?
theater_event_23_05_01_034:
Formerly. Now Cassandra here and I
